evaluation_target.statement: The service shall remain operationally available to authorised users.
evaluation_target.rationale: This is the requirement statement to be evaluated.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Operational availability of the service to authorised users over time.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Service operation under normal and degraded conditions relevant to availability.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The requirement concerns continued availability to a specific user class.

distinctions.contrast_a: authorised users can access the service
distinctions.contrast_b: unauthorised users cannot access the service
distinctions.rationale: Availability is qualified by authorisation, so access scope is the relevant distinction.

orrs.obligation: Specify measurable criteria for service availability as experienced by authorised users versus lack of access for unauthorised users.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: An operational measure can separate successful service access by authorised users from denied access by unauthorised users.

assumptions.statement: Authorisation status can be determined by the service's access-control mechanism.

revalidation_conditions.condition: Revalidate if the access-control model or authorisation mechanism changes.
